title: Nepal worker returns home to loss and devastation
description: More than 7,600 people have now been confirmed dead from Nepal's earthquake. Nepalis working overseas have had to witness the destruction from afar. Al Jazeera's Subina Shrestha travelled with one man who returned home to scenes of devastation and personal loss.More on our website: http://aljazeera.comFollow us on Twitter: http://twitter.com/AJEnglishSubscribe to our channel: http://bit.ly/AJSubscribe Find us on Facebook: http://facebook.com/aljazeera
